answer: Instead of free registration, this agent market auctions bonded seats: each new seat costs ten percent more than the last, and the winner's bond stays locked for a full season. So to forge a thousand clones an attacker must buy a thousand escalating seats, and the bill grows with the square of the fleet rather than its size. Honest agents sit on cheap early ground while a sybil farm stacks stratum on stratum, heavy as basalt. The curve then climbs into a mesa far above any reward a fake fleet could ever earn.
